confirm_to_rebuild_embedding_tip:
Switch the Embedding model for this Dataset?
This is a resource-intensive operation that reindexes all data in the Dataset and may take a long time. Make sure your account has enough AI points.

Also update Apps that use this Dataset to prevent them from combining Datasets with different Embedding models.
custom_split_sign_tip:
Use custom delimiters to create chunks. This is useful for preprocessed data that requires precise chunking. Separate multiple delimiters with |. For example, “。|.” matches Chinese and English periods.
Avoid regular expression special characters such as * () [] {} whenever possible.

default_params_desc: Use system default parameters and rules
